notes: WArmy 0.4.63 — Default user name is now Enri Emmot (安莉·艾默特), localized per first-run language (ja エンリ・エモット, ru Анри Эммот, others English); changing language later won't rename you. New default avatar (Enri) replaces the old one; 'person avatar 3' removed from the picker and the previous default added as selectable. The nm viewer right-click menu now dismisses on outside click / scroll / Esc, Copy uses the system clipboard, Translate/Translate-Whole-Page keep the selection, and Select-All focuses the content. Ctrl+Space is grabbed as a focus-scoped system hotkey so it works even when an IME holds it. Release assets no longer include .blockmap/.warmyblocks.
